newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan firms to build catalyst plant in Kuwait.
newsitem.headline: Japan firms to build catalyst plant in Kuwait.

text.p: A Japanese consortium plans to build a seven-billion-yen crude desulphurising catalyst plant in Kuwait by 1998, a spokesman for Japan Energy Corp, a member of the group, said on Tuesday.
The consortium and its Kuwaiti partners will build the catalyst plant with an annual output capacity of 5,000 tonnes in Shuaiba, the spokesman said.
The plant will manufacture alumina-based catalyst, which removes sulphur content from crude oil.

The Japanese consortium is comprised of Itochu Corp, Tokyo Boeki Development Ltd and Japan International Development Organisation Ltd as well as Japan Energy, while participants on the Kuwaiti side include an investment bank, he said.
The plant is expected to start production by January 1998.
